page.title: System Time & Clock Service
page.desc: Manage host time synchronization policies, supporting RFC 4330 SNTP automatic network sync, two-stage safe slew/step, and one-click browser time alignment.

statusBanner.permissionWarningDesc: The process lacks CAP_SYS_TIME or root privileges. Clock adjustments or RTC writes may be rejected by the kernel.

mode.label: Synchronization Mode
mode.ntpDesc: Smoothly synchronize with candidate NTP servers
mode.manualDesc: Align with client browser time or set manually

timezone.desc: Atomically links host /etc/localtime and refreshes runtime timezone cache.

ntp.title: NTP Network Synchronization
ntp.desc: Configure 1-3 candidate public or private NTP servers. The background service periodically slews the clock.
ntp.minServersWarning: At least 1 NTP server is required
ntp.noServersError: Please provide at least one valid NTP server
ntp.syncing: Requesting high-precision sync from upstream NTP server...
ntp.syncSuccess: Successfully synchronized clock with upstream NTP server

manual.title: Manual Time & Offline Quick Sync
manual.desc: Quickly align device clock with your browser or manually input accurate timestamp in isolated offline environments.
manual.browserSyncDesc: When directly connected to the edge device via laptop, align device time with client time instantaneously.
manual.browserSyncSuccess: System time aligned with browser time and committed to hardware RTC!
manual.syncingBrowser: Writing browser reference time to device RTC...
manual.emptyTimeWarning: Please select a target time first
manual.applyingCustom: Applying custom time and committing to RTC...
manual.applySuccess: Manual time set successfully and committed to hardware RTC

validation.ntpMin: At least 1 NTP server is required
validation.ntpMax: At most 5 NTP servers can be configured
